description: This PHP class defines the data transfer object (DTO) LDAPAuthProvider used in the LDAP authentication plugin for OrangeHRM. The class encapsulates LDAP provider information such as user DN and user ID.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing an LDAP authentication provider, storing user distinguished name (DN) and user ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing LDAPAuthProvider with user DN and user ID.

methods.name: getUserDN
methods.description: Returns the distinguished name (DN) of the LDAP user.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the LDAP user.
